title: Oil prices jump after major producers announce deeper output cuts
body: Crude oil prices jumped sharply on Friday evening after a group of major producers announced deeper output cuts. Brent crude rose more than six percent in after-hours trading. Higher crude prices typically lift revenue for integrated producers such as ExxonMobil. Airlines including Delta Air Lines face higher jet fuel costs when crude prices rise.
